lantea_owner.text: Table by the window? Lovely. We serve cake, tea and opinions on the weather. The opinions are free.
Up on the hill stands the Ashton Memorial, a great green-domed folly. Lord Ashton built it in 1909 in memory of his wife.

then.text: One cream tea each, my love, or the scones will run out. Off you go.

else.text: Have a cream tea, on me. Jam first or cream first, I stay out of that fight.
